_comment: The groups of pocketone.dev's extension catalogue. Each extension lists itself: `title`, `group` (an id below) and `summary` in the front matter of ext/<name>/README.md, which becomes /docs/extensions/<name> (its other top-level .md files, CHANGELOG.md aside, become guides under it). Within a group, extensions are sorted by title. `links` are folders with no page of their own: the catalogue points at that file on GitHub instead.

groups.title: Standard extensions
groups.intro: These ship with `pocketone` and add no work to an app that doesn't use them.

groups.title: Run many instances
groups.intro: Host hundreds of PocketBase instances in one process, across regions.

groups.title: Services for your instances
groups.intro: Shared services a host gives every instance it runs.

groups.title: Sell it as a service
groups.intro: Accounts, quotas and billing, for running PocketBase as a service.

groups.title: For extension authors
groups.intro: The extension contract and tools for building and testing extensions.
